title: Refinement square for the reconstructed integral compositor
statement: For ComparisonFamily C and A=C.coefficient E, fix a compositor datum and a second datum whose exterior compactifications refine cf,cg,ch with legs rf,rg,rh as in [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data]. For uniform K the exact equality integralCompositor ≫ integralRefinement(rh)_K = integralRefinement(rg)_(P_f K) ≫ P_gprime(integralRefinement(rf)_K) ≫ integralCompositorprime holds. There is no rationalization or condensed realization in this assertion. Dependencies: [def-pur-condensed-compositor-realization-data], [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization].

proof.text: Apply the faithful coefficient-model equivalence and cancel the inserted reduction-delta/counit pair in each compositor. The actual limit-presentation refinement square gives the coordinate expression for integralRefinement. Move the two input refinement maps through delta and beta by naturality and the reduction square of C.refinement. Paste the corresponding proper/open whole-system refinement squares and cancel the pinned inverse refinement factors. Apply total limit, paste the delta squares, cancel the output delta isomorphism and reflect equality through the model and full inclusion.

lean.statement: theorem condensedCompositorIntegralRefinement (C : ComparisonFamily l k) (X Y Z : CondensedERealization.Base k) (f : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme) (g : Y.scheme ⟶ Z.scheme) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g) (ch : Compactification (f ≫ g)) (d : Compactification (cf.g ≫ cg.i)) (c : Compactification (f ≫ g)) (r : c.Refinement (composite k X Y Z f g cf cg d)) (s : c.Refinement ch) (cf' : Compactification f) (cg' : Compactification g) (ch' : Compactification (f ≫ g)) (rf : cf'.Refinement cf) (rg : cg'.Refinement cg) (rh : ch'.Refinement ch) (d' : Compactification (cf'.g ≫ cg'.i)) (c' : Compactification (f ≫ g)) (r' : c'.Refinement (composite k X Y Z f g cf' cg' d')) (s' : c'.Refinement ch') (K : CondensedERealization.Integral l E X.scheme) (hK : Uniform l E k X K) : let A := C.coefficient E integralCompositor l E k A X Y Z f g cf cg ch d c r s K hK ≫ (integralRefinement l E k A X Z (f ≫ g) rh).app K = (integralRefinement l E k A Y Z g rg).app ((P l E k A X Y f cf).obj K) ≫ (P l E k A Y Z g cg').map ((integralRefinement l E k A X Y f rf).app K) ≫ integralCompositor l E k A X Y Z f g cf' cg' ch' d' c' r' s' K hK
